name: Session Recharge
description: Preserves important architectural decisions and user requests that get lost during compaction and long sessions. Automatically extracts structured session memory (goals, decisions, state, blockers, corrections) before compaction and re-injects it after. Can also be triggered mid-session anytime you want Claude to refocus on what's been decided.
longDescription:
Ships **1 command** and **2 hooks**.

- **Commands** (1): `session-recharge`
- **Hooks** (2): `PreCompact`, `SessionStart`

Installs with `claude plugin install session-recharge@claude-community` from `edo-ceder/session-recharge`.

Preserves important architectural decisions and user requests that get lost during compaction and long sessions. Automatically extracts structured session memory (goals, decisions, state, blockers, corrections) before compaction and re-injects it after. Can also be triggered mid-session anytime you want Claude to refocus on what's been decided.
